name: 3236-solodecode-dsv2lite-1gpu
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite -- ungated, ~30 GB of bf16 weights, already in the local HF cache.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
parallelism: tp1. No tensor, pipeline, expert or data parallelism.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 150 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix structure: prompts centred on 256 tokens (stdev 32, clamped 64-512) and a fixed 512 output tokens per request, pinned by `ignore_eos: true` and `temperature: 0` in `spec.backend.extras.body`. Seed 42.
purpose: A single-user drafting assistant generating 512-token replies from short prompts, one request at a time on one H100.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only. A nested block is DROPPED by the flat parser, and the engine then runs
# without the mechanism this file declares.

model-path: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite

# The checkpoint ships its own configuration/modeling modules and its tokenizer needs them.
trust-remote-code: true

tp-size: 1

# LOAD-BEARING, not cosmetic: the checkpoint advertises 163840 positions, and at that window the
# engine's ReqToTokenPool int32 tensor alone exceeds a terabyte and the server never starts. 4096
# is the native window and bounds nothing here -- the longest possible request is 512 + 512.
context-length: 4096

mem-fraction-static: 0.85

# Every prompt is an independent synthetic draw, so there is nothing to reuse.
disable-radix-cache: true

random-seed: 42
